summary: Implemented Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) with the LambdaD and LambdaDict aliases, added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and created tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was run or committed, so the tests and docs build are unverified. The tests cover identity and slicing only; the non-callable AssertionError, empty-keys ValueError, and iterable-callable cases have no tests yet.
